newsitem.title: FRANCE: BT to take Generale des Eaux telcom stake - source.
newsitem.headline: BT to take Generale des Eaux telcom stake - source.

text.p: British Telecom Plc is buying a minority stake in Cegetel, the telecomunications unit of French utilities company Cie Generale des Eaux, a source familiar with the deal said on Thursday.
"BT will take a minority, but significant, stake in Cegetel," the source told Reuters.
The source declined to give financial details.
Generale des Eaux announced the launch of Cegetel earlier this month as the vehicle for its ambitions to be a major telecommunications player, rivalling state-owned France Telecom.

British Telecommunications Plc has long harboured hopes of cracking the French market and unveiled on September 17 in Lyon, central France, its "Pleiade" service for a national service for long-distance calls for French companies.
BT and Generale des Eaux are both holding separate news conferences later on Thursday morning.
